trials.claim: Lifetime access to Musicsesame Stock Music Library
trials.claimQuote: Lifetime access to Musicsesame - Stock Music Library
trials.reasoning: The binding terms say the license is revocable and ends on termination or expiry, requiring you to stop new uses. That outweighs the pricing page's marketing promise of permanent lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: When granted, your rights are limited to a revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable license defined by your plan or license document.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because the license is expressly revocable and limited rather than permanent.

exhibits.quote: Upon termination or expiry of your plan, your license ends and you must cease any new uses of the content.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access is undermined because termination ends the license and requires stopping new uses.

exhibits.quote: Our Per Channel and Unlimited plans are Lifetime — once you purchase, you have permanent access to the catalog and can use the music in your projects forever without any recurring fees.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states its plans are Lifetime with permanent catalog access and no recurring fees.

exhibits.quote: The Per Channel and Unlimited plans are one-time purchases — you pay once and enjoy lifetime access to your plan's features and music downloads.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms one-time purchase gives lifetime access to features and music downloads.

trials.reasoning: A buyer review confirms paying $75 for the product. The $14.50 monthly and €399 listings are the vendor's regular prices, not evidence that deal buyers were charged those amounts.

exhibits.quote:
### Monthly

$14.50/month

- Download any tracks from the library and use them commercially
exhibits.argument: The $75 claim is misleading because the vendor lists a $14.50 monthly price for commercial library use.

exhibits.quote:
### Unlimited Channels

€399 Lifetime

- Download any tracks from the library and use them commercially
exhibits.argument: The $75 claim is misleading because the vendor lists a €399 lifetime tier for unlimited channels.

exhibits.quote: Go on site and listen to tracks first before you buy!! Don't waste $75 like I did.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they paid $75 for the product.

trials.claim: Royalty free music for YouTube, ads, films, documentaries, podcasts and more
trials.claimQuote: Royalty free music for YouTube, ads, films, documentaries, podcasts, and more
trials.reasoning: The pricing shows the Per Channel plan excludes films and ODT/OTT platforms, and films are only added with the Unlimited plan. So films are not included generally as the broad claim suggests.

exhibits.quote:
- ✕ ODT / OTT platforms

- ✕ Films (theatrical, festivals, VOD)
exhibits.argument: The broad films and more promise is undermined because the Per Channel plan expressly excludes films and ODT/OTT platforms.

exhibits.quote: • Unlimited adds National broadcast, ODT/OTT platforms and Films.
exhibits.argument: The broad films promise is undermined because films are reserved as an Unlimited-tier add-on, not included generally.

exhibits.quote: One simple license for web, social, ads, podcasts, broadcast and in-store — worldwide, forever.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states one license covers ads, podcasts and other uses worldwide forever.

exhibits.quote: MusicSesame has one of the best quality royalty free music library! Each piece is unique and beautifully composed.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms it is a royalty free music library with quality composed pieces.

my only issue is I burned through the 200+ files quickly and am already in re-use territory.
